title: UniMind: Calibration-Aware Scheduling and Placement for Quantum-Accelerated AI Middleware — Code, Calibration Snapshots, QPU Job Logs and Analysis Scripts
description: Measurement study on a 156-qubit superconducting device (ibm_marrakesh) plus 337 hourly calibration snapshots (71 epochs, marrakesh 111 + kingston 109 + fez 117; 337 total / 328 in Kaplan-Meier, 3 backends, calibration-only). Includes D0-D3 daily snapshots (2026-08-29 to 09-01, D0-D2 QPU-anchored, D3 calibration-only, 6 inter-day pairs), hourly telemetry (2026-08-31 to 09-02), E2E angle batches (frozen+refresh, n=30/arm, job IDs daadeocjbipc73ffq83g / daadeosjbipc73ffq840), J(G) real-label suite (k=9-18, daadgmmrbfbs73cijmbg), all analysis scripts and processed results (drift_analysis, refresh_policy_analysis with 144 threshold combos, power_analysis with Wilson/Fisher/MDE, jg_feature_ablation, workload_connectivity_drift, ranking_margin_analysis, survival_analysis.json with S(t)=1.0 to 15h, 0/71 triggers). Every table is traceable to a QPU job ID or calibration JSON. Code is MIT, data is CC-BY-4.0.
notes: If you use calibration_total JSON or E2E batches, please cite the TC paper (IEEE Transactions on Computers, submitted) and the Zenodo DOI. Name-disambiguation: not the Brain-Computer Interface UniMind.
